metadata.title: Verified Mode Routing, Write/Edit Safety, Smart Mutation Gates, and P49.5 Bridge Readiness
metadata.description: PlanSpec v5 alpha2 JSON plan for P44.6. Converts write, edit, smart write, and smart edit from prose-level agent behavior into explicit EngineMode, readiness gates, route signals, runtime adapters, evidence ledger entries, and P49.5 bridge artifacts.

notes: v4.1.1 adapter compiles to executable lock.
P44.6 is a bridge-quality mode routing and mutation-safety phase; it must not implement P45 async assembly runtime.
Markdown previews are generated artifacts only and are non-authoritative.
